name: 人人视频去广告
description: 人人（多多）视频去广告 · 来源 重写库
text:
#!name=人人视频去广告
#!desc=人人（多多）视频去广告 · 来源 重写库
#!author=ddgksf2013

[MITM]
hostname = api.rr.tv

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/\w{3}\/level\/info, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response https://api.rr.tv/v3plus/index/channel\?pageNum=1&position=CHANNEL_INDEX, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/app\/config\/h5NativeBar, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/v3plus\/index\/channel\?pageNum=1&position=CHANNEL_MY, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/user\/privilege\/list, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/ad\/getAll, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https:\/\/api\.rr\.tv\/drama\/app\/get_combined_drama_detail, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://api.rr.tv/watch/v4, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https://api.rr.tv/user/profile, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deezertidal/private/master/js-backup/Script/rrtv_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
